Entity kinds:
  project (PROJ) statuses=draft, active, paused, done initial=draft archive=done
  epic (EPIC) statuses=draft, active, paused, done initial=draft archive=done
  version (VER) statuses=draft, active, paused, done initial=draft archive=done
  initiative (INIT) statuses=draft, active, paused, done initial=draft archive=done
  prd (PRD) statuses=draft, in-progress, approved, superseded initial=draft archive=approved
  userStory (US) statuses=draft, ready, in-progress, done, superseded initial=draft archive=done
  adr (ADR) statuses=current, superseded, archived initial=current archive=archived
  issue (ISS) statuses=todo, in-progress, blocked, deferred, done initial=todo archive=done
  debt (DEBT) statuses=open, resolved, archived initial=open archive=archived
  handoff (HO) statuses=active, done initial=active archive=done
  plan (PLAN) statuses=draft, in-progress, ready, superseded initial=draft archive=superseded

Relation types: blocks, constrains, contains, creates, decomposes, fixes, handsOff, informs, owns, records, relatesTo, resolves, supersedes, taggedWith, tracks

Structural relation types: contains, owns, records, tracks, creates, decomposes

Allowed relations:
  project --contains--> epic
  epic --contains--> initiative
  project --owns--> version
  initiative --taggedWith--> version
  issue --taggedWith--> version
  initiative --supersedes--> initiative
  initiative --relatesTo--> initiative

  initiative --owns--> plan
  prd --supersedes--> prd
  plan --informs--> prd
  project --records--> adr
  epic --records--> adr
  initiative --records--> adr
  project --records--> debt
  epic --records--> debt
  initiative --records--> debt
  issue --records--> debt
  initiative --tracks--> issue
  prd --creates--> userStory
  userStory --supersedes--> userStory
  issue --decomposes--> issue
  issue --fixes--> userStory
  adr --constrains--> issue
  epic --resolves--> debt
  initiative --resolves--> debt
  issue --resolves--> debt
  adr --supersedes--> adr
  issue --blocks--> issue

  debt --relatesTo--> epic

  debt --relatesTo--> adr
  debt --relatesTo--> issue
  debt --relatesTo--> debt
  handoff --handsOff--> initiative
  handoff --handsOff--> prd
  handoff --handsOff--> userStory
  handoff --handsOff--> adr
  handoff --handsOff--> issue
  handoff --handsOff--> debt

Structural parent rules:
  project --contains--> epic
  epic --contains--> initiative
  project --owns--> version

  initiative --owns--> plan

  initiative --tracks--> issue
  prd --creates--> userStory

Context:
  storage=database scopes=default, project, initiative default=default
  list: agent-issues context list --json
  read: agent-issues context show [<entityOrProjectOrInitiativeId>|default] --json
  search: agent-issues context search <query> [--view <all|global|initiatives>] --json
  conflicts: agent-issues context conflicts [<query>] [--view <all|initiatives>] --json
  initialize: agent-issues context set --scope <entityOrProjectOrInitiativeId|default> --title <title> --body-file <path|-> --json
  define term: agent-issues context define <term> --scope <entityOrProjectOrInitiativeId|default> --body-file <path|-> [--avoid <comma-separated terms>] --json
  forget term: agent-issues context forget <term> --scope <entityOrProjectOrInitiativeId|default> --json
  term fields: term, definition, avoid, createdAt, updatedAt

Issue comments:
  storage=database parent=issue prefix=COM
  add: agent-issues comment add <issueId> --body-file <path|-> [--reference <issueId>] --json
  list: agent-issues comment list <issueId> [--before <cursor>] [--all] --json
  edit: agent-issues comment edit <issueId> <commentId> --body-file <path|-> [--reference <issueId>] --json
  delete: agent-issues comment delete <issueId> <commentId> --json
  history: agent-issues comment history <commentId> --json
  fields: id, reference, issueId, body, referencedIssueIds, revision, contentHash, tombstone, createdAt, updatedAt

Plan entries:
  storage=database parent=plan prefix=PLAN_ENTRY
  add: agent-issues plan-entry add <planId> --role <role> --body-file <path|-> [--reference <entityId>] --json
  link: agent-issues link <planEntryId> informs <targetId> --json
  unlink: agent-issues unlink <planEntryId> informs <targetId> --json
  fields: id, reference, planId, role, body, referencedEntityIds, supersededEntryIds, revision, contentHash, tombstone, createdAt, updatedAt
